slide1.title: Take control of your money
slide1.body: See everything in one place — accounts, spending, and savings — with a health score that's fair to your income.

slide2.title: Your transactions, captured for you
slide2.body: Forward a mobile-money SMS or snap a receipt — Mulinda turns it into a transaction. You just approve.

slide3.title: Save, borrow and invest wisely
slide3.body: Set goals, get reminders, check if you can afford a loan, and learn when you're ready to invest — with a coach who knows your money.
